data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, the name Endless represents the eternal and boundless nature of the universe. It is a symbol of the infinite and endless cycle of creation and destruction. The name Endless carries the meaning “Boundless, Infinite” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Endless usually hope their child will grow to embody boundless, infinite and live with faith, good character and purpose.
